entry_state: Chapter13 closes with native-XBRL source selection and a PDF comparator, while separating source selection, resolved environment and executed compatibility. Inline transformations, occurrence preservation, duplicate comparisons and the Apple annual/interim matches establish concrete exchange requirements. Dependency ranges constrain a future environment but do not establish installation, validation, licenses for all components or runtime acceptance. Chapter14 must now state the evidence needed to accept the design and its implementation.
exit_state: Acceptance requires separate evidence for engineering, accounting and scientific validity. Core conformance cases and bounded extraction, reconstruction, DSL-comparison and forecast protocols are specified without treating local demonstrations as promotion evidence. The forecast information cutoff requires exact retained versions and actual availability evidence. E1 preserves complete-package coverage and source errors; E2 tests soundness and completeness within a declared finite scope. E3 begins with operating cash flow and a joint cash/debt target; its scoring protocol continues.
findings: Chapter14 opens by distinguishing reference design checks from a production implementation.

The conformance table covers 18 cases across journals, typed units, revisions, continuous families, duplicates, conflicts, timeouts, funding failure, measurement timing, event replay and probability-weighted mixtures.
The extraction section asks for complete disclosure packages and separates source-linked correctness, unresolved coverage, note obligations, reconciliation failures and invented facts.
The DSL baseline compares equivalent tasks through typed Python and DSL interfaces; a few pilots cannot establish superiority.

Forecast protocol fixes information boundaries and comparator ladder, preserves unknown targets in denominators, separates set coverage from probabilities and allows candidate rejection to motivate repair.
The nine-issuer development panel, 192 accepted reports, 31 pilot annotations and 136 unresolved dates are explicitly not treated as independent observations or verified availability evidence.
